findings.detail: TEAM Services maturity was parsed as 1/28/2023, but the matching filing row states 1/28/2033.
Micro Merchant Systems identifier fields do not match the filing row, whose maturity is 12/14/2027 rather than 2/2/2026 or 2/2/2033.
Leaf Home XBRL twin maturity 11/15/2029 is wrong; the filing row and parsed identifier both state 9/4/2031.
Midwest Eye Services flagged dates in 2030 do not match the filing maturity of 8/20/2027.
Terra Millennium XBRL twin maturity 9/4/2031 is wrong; the filing row and parsed identifier state 11/1/2030.

rationale: This is a Class 2 within-row adjudication. Direct raw schedule rows resolve all five maturity conflicts. The TEAM, Leaf Home, and Terra Millennium filing rows give exact maturity cells that expose a year typo or a maturity copied from another position. Micro Merchant Systems and Midwest Eye Services additionally show broader identifier/row misalignment: the flagged investment descriptors and dates do not match the issuer's filing rows. The pattern is a localized extraction or row-association defect, not a bad check.
